/corecraft/individual-equipment/merry-go.description: Four colourful bird seats sit around the Animal Merry-Go-Round, so each child gets a character to ride. It is sized for small children, with a Key User Group of 3 to 6 years, and seats four at a time. Children push off with their feet or have an adult turn the platform, and they quickly learn to hold on and balance as it spins. The round platform is 6'2" across and the safe play area is a circle of 12'2" diameter. The multi colour finish makes it a cheerful centre piece for a pre-primary section or a society toddler corner. Galvanised pipes and roto-moulded seats carry our 3-year warranty, and bearings carry 1 year. Ask us for a layout drawing that shows the full circle.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/merry-go.spec_paragraph: The frame is galvanised pipe and the bird seats are roto-moulded, so they stand up to sun and rain. Our team sets it up self-standing or grouts it in. Keep the 12'2" circle clear so children stepping off do not walk into another piece, and check the central bearing for smooth turning during maintenance.
flags: Named Animal MGR, but the image shows only bird seats. Check whether other animal seats are offered.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/merry-go.description: The Bucket Spinner is a single light blue bucket seat mounted on a red tilted post. A child sits inside the bucket and spins, and the tilt of the post makes each turn rise and dip a little. The deep seat holds the child securely, which is why it suits the 3 to 6 years Key User Group. Only one child rides at a time, so it works best as one of several small pieces in a nursery or society play corner rather than the main attraction. The seat comes in Baby Blue. Our standard warranty gives 3 years on galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts and 1 year on bearings. Ask us where a Bucket Spinner would fit beside your existing equipment.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/merry-go.spec_paragraph: The post is galvanised steel and the bucket seat is roto-moulded, so neither rusts in wet weather. Installation is self-standing or grouted. The spin depends on its bearing, so check at every maintenance visit that the seat turns smoothly. Leave clear space around it so a turning child cannot strike a nearby frame.
flags: Product Area and Safe Play Area are NA.
A single-seat spinner is listed under Merry-Go-Round. Consider a Spinner category.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/merry-go.description: On the Cage Spinner, a child sits on an orange seat inside a Lavender steel basket and spins around. The basket wraps around the seat, so the child can hold on from any side while turning. It is meant for the 3 to 6 years Key User Group and seats one child. Spinning helps young children develop balance and a sense of their body in motion, and many enjoy pushing themselves round. Its small size means it can sit near a toddler swing or spring rider in a compact play area. Galvanised pipe on this spinner is covered for 3 years and bearings for 1 year against manufacturing defects. Send us a photo of your play corner and we will suggest a spot for it.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/merry-go.spec_paragraph: The basket and post are galvanised steel finished in Lavender, and the seat is roto-moulded. We install it self-standing or grouted into the ground. Because a spinning child leans outward, keep other equipment well away from the basket, and inspect the bearing and basket welds during regular maintenance.
flags: Product Area and Safe Play Area are NA.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/merry-go.description: Shaped like a flower and finished in Royal Turquoise, the Flower Spinner is a single-seat spinner for children in the 3 to 6 years Key User Group. One child sits on it at a time and turns it round, learning to hold on and keep steady as it spins. The flower shape gives a nursery garden or society toddler corner a soft, friendly look. It also pairs well with our other spinners if you want a small cluster. Roto-moulded parts on the Flower Spinner are covered by our 3-year warranty, with 1 year on bearings. Ask us for a layout drawing if you are planning a small play area around it.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/merry-go.spec_paragraph: The flower seat is roto-moulded and the support is galvanised steel, both resistant to rust and weather. It can be installed self-standing or grouted, depending on your ground. Leave open space around it so a spinning child stays clear of other pieces, and check that the seat turns freely during maintenance.
flags: Product Area and Safe Play Area are NA.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/merry-go.description: The Four Seater Merry-Go-Round is a classic round platform with red and yellow seats for four children. It suits a wide age band, with a Key User Group of 3 to 9 years, so siblings of different ages can ride together. Older children often push the platform while younger ones sit, which makes this a social piece as much as a ride. The platform is 6'5" in diameter and the safe play area is a 12'5" circle. It is a dependable choice for a school, society or public garden that wants one merry-go-round for many children. Colours are multi colour. Our 3-year warranty covers galvanised pipe and roto-moulded seats, and bearings are covered for 1 year. Ask us for a quote and a site layout.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/merry-go.spec_paragraph: The Four Seater is built on a galvanised steel frame with roto-moulded seats and a central bearing. On site, we fix it self-standing or by grouting. Children run around the platform to push it, so keep the full 12'5" circle clear and level, and grease or check the bearing as part of routine maintenance.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/merry-go.description: Three colourful horse seats stand on the round platform of the Horse Merry-Go-Round. Each child straddles a horse and holds on as the platform turns, which feels like a small fairground ride. It suits the 3 to 6 years Key User Group and seats three. At 4' across, it is one of our more compact merry-go-rounds, and it needs a safe play area of 10' in diameter. That makes it a good option for a nursery, a play school or a small society garden. The horses come in multi colour. Galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts are covered by our 3-year warranty, and bearings by 1 year. Share your site size and we will show it on a layout drawing.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/merry-go.spec_paragraph: The horses are roto-moulded and fixed to a galvanised steel platform that turns on a central bearing. We choose between grouting and a self-standing base once we know your ground. Keep the 10' circle free of other equipment and walkways, and check during maintenance that each horse is firmly fixed and the platform turns smoothly.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/merry-go.description: Elephant-shaped seats give the Jumbo Four Seater Merry-Go-Round its name. Four children each sit on a colourful elephant while the platform turns, and the seat shape gives them something solid to hold. It is meant for the 3 to 9 years Key User Group, so it works in a primary school as well as a society play area. The platform is 6'8" in diameter, slightly larger than our standard four seater, and the safe play area is a 12'8" circle. The elephants come in multi colour and make a strong theme piece for a park. Roto-moulded seats and galvanised pipes carry a 3-year warranty, with 1 year on bearings. Ask us for a layout drawing of your play area.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/merry-go.spec_paragraph: Each elephant seat is roto-moulded and bolted to a galvanised steel platform. Installation is self-standing or grouted, depending on your ground. A turning platform of 6'8" needs room for children to step off safely, so keep the 12'8" circle clear and inspect the seat fixings and bearing during maintenance.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/merry-go.description: Children ride the Laminate Standing Merry-Go-Round on their feet. They stand on a yellow platform and hold a central steering wheel while it turns, which takes more balance than a seated ride. It is designed for the 5 to 10 years Key User Group and carries four children at a time. The platform is 4' x 4' and the safe play area is 10' x 10'. Standing play gives older children a bit more challenge, so this suits a primary school or a park where the younger merry-go-rounds feel too tame. Colours are Play Yellow and Knight Blue. Composite laminates and galvanised pipes come with our 3-year warranty, and bearings with 1 year. Ask us for a quote.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/merry-go.spec_paragraph: The standing deck is composite laminate on a galvanised steel frame, which resists moisture and corrosion. We install it self-standing or grouted. Keep the 10' x 10' area clear and use an impact-absorbing surface, since children may step off while it is still turning. Check the steering wheel and bearing during maintenance.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/merry-go.description: The Roto Platform Merry-Go-Round is a green rotating platform ringed with yellow hand rails. Children stand or sit on the deck and hold the rails as it turns. It carries 4 to 6 children, the largest group among our 4' x 4' merry-go-rounds, and is meant for the 5 to 10 years Key User Group. The open deck lets children choose how they ride, which keeps older children interested for longer. The safe play area is 10' x 10'. Colours are Sea Green and Play Yellow. The roto-moulded platform and galvanised rails are covered by our 3-year warranty, with 1 year on bearings. Tell us how many children use your play area and we will suggest the right merry-go-round.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/merry-go.spec_paragraph: The platform is roto-moulded and the hand rails are galvanised steel, a pairing that copes with sun and rain. It goes in self-standing or grouted. With up to six children on board, check the central bearing regularly and keep the 10' x 10' zone free of benches, edging and other equipment.
flags: Several merry-go-rounds share the same 4' x 4' product area and 10' x 10' safe play area. Confirm each is correct.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/merry-go.description: On the Roto Seating Merry-Go-Round, children sit on a yellow moulded seat under a steel canopy frame while the unit turns. The canopy frame gives the ride a distinct shape and gives children something to hold above their heads. It seats three and is meant for the 5 to 10 years Key User Group. The product area is 4' x 4' and the safe play area is 10' x 10', so it fits a school or society play area without taking much ground. The finish is multi colour. Our 3-year warranty covers galvanised pipe and roto-moulded parts against manufacturing defects, and the bearing has a 1-year warranty. Ask us for a layout drawing showing where it fits.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/merry-go.spec_paragraph: The canopy frame is galvanised steel and the seat is roto-moulded plastic. Installation is self-standing or grouted. Keep the 10' x 10' area clear around the turning seat, and during maintenance check the canopy joints and the bearing so the ride turns smoothly.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/merry-go.description: The Roto Wheel Go Round puts an orange steering wheel at the centre of a small merry-go-round, with pink and blue seats around it. Children take turns steering and riding, so play often turns into a pretend drive. It suits the 3 to 9 years Key User Group and seats four. The unit takes up 4' x 4' and needs a safe play area of 10' x 10'. Its colours and steering wheel make it popular with younger children in a society garden or play school. The finish is multi colour. Galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts carry a 3-year warranty, and the bearing is covered for 1 year. Send us your site details for a layout drawing and a quote.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/merry-go.spec_paragraph: The seats and steering wheel are roto-moulded, and the base frame is galvanised steel. Grouting or a self-standing base, whichever suits your ground, holds it in place. Keep the 10' x 10' zone clear, place it on an impact-absorbing surface, and check that the steering wheel and bearing turn freely at each maintenance visit.
